scope: Normative finite CSV arithmetic plus capability, idempotency and current-proof protocol. Not a general semantic or intelligence proof.

normative_spec.encoding: UTF-8 exact bytes; no BOM; maximum 32768 bytes
normative_spec.CSV: strict RFC-style quoted fields; LF or CRLF; no blank rows or trimming; optional final newline
normative_spec.arithmetic: exact signed integer minor units; never binary floating point
normative_spec.totals: one per currency sorted by ASCII currency; exact fixed two decimals, no leading plus or leading zeros, zero 0.00
normative_spec.capability: 256 bit random secret; store only SHA-256 hash; constant-time application comparison when applicable; never embed secret in proof/log/URL

csv_cases.note: Decimal addition must produce exactly 30 minor units.
RFC escaped quote parses, but resulting identifier is outside the accepted ASCII subset.
No source code, expressions, URLs or arbitrary operation are executable input.
